name: Paolo Spaghetti
features: light olive skin, dark wavy hair, hazel eyes, classic Italian features, athletic build, youthful face, smooth skin, short well-groomed beard
bio: A young Italian driver from Verona whose love for speed is matched only by his love for his grandmother's pasta recipes. His true name is Paolo Santiago Manggiabrocoli and no wonder why he choose that particular last name instead of his own.
